subject: Staged commitment release cadence + PO automation for annual prepay
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Claire Donovan <claire@brightlane.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Staged commitment release cadence + PO automation for annual prepay

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, I put together a proposed approach for the annual prepay commitment that should make collections and VAT handling smoother on your side while giving you predictable capacity release windows. Attached: redwood_staged_commitment_schedule_v1.xlsx (staged release schedule) and a short drawdown ledger sample.

Key highlights:
- Staged releases: commitment funds are unlocked in 4 quarterly tranches tied to usage thresholds (we'll wire invoices as each tranche is activated).
- PO automation: we can accept a single umbrella PO + per-tranche PO acknowledgements to match our invoicing system — that reduces manual remittance work for you.
- Drawdown ledger: continuous CSV feed (sample attached) will be shared nightly; you can use it for internal reconciliation.
- VAT/invoice delivery: Kim will validate the VAT routing and provide sample tax invoices. If BrightLane needs VAT-exempted invoices we can flag them per entity.

Next steps I recommend:
1) You confirm the preferred PO number pattern (single umbrella PO + suffixes, or unique PO per tranche).
2) Procurement sends the primary PO to procure@redwood.com and cc's kimberly.park@redwood.com.
3) We issue the first tranche invoice upon PO acceptance and route VAT evidence.

If useful I can also generate a DocuSign for the payment schedule and the standard addendum for prepay terms — saves back-and-forth on signatures.

Attaching the schedule and ledger sample for your procurement team to review.

Thanks —
Evelyn Hart
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 (415) 555-0183

Subject: Re: Staged commitment release cadence + PO automation for annual prepay

Evelyn —

Appreciate the breakdown and the attachments. A couple quick procurement questions before we loop finance:

- PO pattern: we prefer an umbrella PO with tranche suffixes (PO-BL-2026-0001-T1, etc.). Is that compatible with your invoice numbering?
- VAT: BrightLane is VAT-registered in the UK; we'll need VAT invoices that show our VAT ID for reclaim. Can Kim confirm that invoices will include VAT line items and the correct entity name?
- Can you confirm the remittance account for wire transfers and whether your invoices support ACH? We need bank details on the invoice.

If you can confirm those three items we can route the umbrella PO to procure@brightlane.com by end of week. Once PO is received, do you typically issue the tranche invoice immediately or after the usage threshold is hit?

—Claire
Claire Donovan
Head of Platform Ops | BrightLane
claire@brightlane.com

Thanks Claire — answers below and a suggested mutual action plan (MAP) inline so we can keep track: 

1) PO numbering: Yes, umbrella PO + tranche suffix is compatible. Our invoicing system will accept PO-structured references and will emit invoice numbers that include the tranche suffix for easy matching. Please provide your PO pattern when you send the umbrella PO; we'll confirm mapping.

2) VAT: Kimberly — can you confirm VAT invoice routing and sample fields? (see cc)

3) Remittance: We support wire (preferred) and ACH (US customers). Bank details will be placed on each tranche invoice; I also shared the DocuSign link if you'd rather sign the payment schedule and standard prepay addendum electronically: https://na1.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?env=na1&acct=12345&pfid=abcde

Suggested MAP / timeline:
- Day 0 (you send umbrella PO to procure@brightlane.com) — Redwood issues tranche T1 invoice within 24 hours and attaches VAT invoice.
- Nightly (Day 1 onwards) — drawdown_ledger.csv pushed to your SFTP / secure link for reconciliation.
- Tranche activation — subsequent tranches issue invoices as usage thresholds are reached or on scheduled quarterly release (whichever occurs earlier).

Attachments: I re-attached the schedule and a drawdown sample for procurement to forward to finance. I'll also add an automated webhook to your SFTP for the ledger export if you want it routed into your ERP.

Let me know if you want me to produce an example invoice populated with your VAT ID prior to sending the PO — that often speeds up finance approval.

Best,
Evelyn

Attachments referenced:
- redwood_staged_commitment_schedule_v1.xlsx (xlsx)

Claire — quick follow on from our tax/finance sync:

- VAT handling: Kimberly will attach BrightLane's VAT certificate once you confirm which legal entity (UK Ltd vs EU sub) will be billed. That will determine whether we apply UK VAT or treat the invoice as EU zero-rated.
- Invoice samples: Evelyn will prepare a mock invoice with your VAT ID populated so your AP team can validate fields.
- Remit details: We will include both our ACH and wire instructions on the tranche invoice; for EU wires we'll use our EUR account to avoid FX recharges.

Kimberly — can you drop the VAT cert and the sample invoice (populated with Claire's VAT ID) into this thread? I'll then update the MAP and push the DocuSign for the prepay addendum so procurement can sign against the umbrella PO.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
